# Motion dependencies

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 are vendored from the official npm `gsap` package via jsDelivr. The copyright and license notices remain in both distribution files.

- https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js

The site uses static HTML and loads these local files directly. No package installation or build step is required.
